name: Primary Passkey Real-Manager Proof
summary: Registers real AppUserPasskeyManager proof for email-first primary Passkey Sign In, including required user verification, challenge and credential ownership binding, signature-counter advancement, and the invariant that primary Passkey proof does not record MFA freshness.
notes: EmailPasskeyAuthenticationService and the real AppUserPasskeyManager are both exercised; only repositories, FIDO2 itself, logging and configuration are mocked infrastructure seams.

Primary authentication intentionally calls BeginAuthenticationOptionsAsync with user verification required while CompleteAuthenticationAsync receives isStepUp=false, so successful primary Passkey authentication does not mutate LastMfaDateTimeUtc.
Runtime execution evidence remains separate from this authored proof binding.

sourceReferences.note: Resolves normalized email to the expected durable user and separates UV-required begin semantics from primary completion bookkeeping.
Real challenge ownership, credential ownership, WebAuthn verification, signature-counter and MFA-freshness logic under proof.
